I've confirmed all the checked items - roughly 18-20 total, covering overall dimensions, chain segments, room names and areas, scale, plan number, date, and door widths/openings matching leaf lengths. Now I'm compiling the final list to present.

I'll decide to include the chain-closure issue as a separate finding despite the double-counting risk, since it's informative, though I'll leave its labeled_value null since nothing single is printed wrong there. I'll also note in the summary that BAD is only reachable through SCHLAFEN, but not flag it as a formal error.

I've checked the plan against its own vector geometry. Summary of what I found:

**Verified correct:** scale 1:100 (drawn geometry matches printed dimensions exactly), overall 10.00 × 7.00 m, wall thicknesses 30 cm (exterior) and 11.5 cm (interior), all three door openings match their leaf/swing radii (1.00 / 1.00 / 0.90 m), title block.

**Errors found:** the horizontal dimension chain does not close (30 + 5.86 + 11.5 + 4.00 + 30 = 10.575 m ≠ 10.00 m), because two chain segments are mislabelled; and all three room areas are understated relative to the drawn rooms.

| Element | Plan says | Measured |
|---|---|---|
| Chain seg. WOHNEN width | 5.86 m | 5.80 m |
| Chain seg. SCHLAFEN/BAD width | 4.00 m | 3.485 m |
| WOHNEN area | 31.2 m² | 37.12 m² (5.80 × 6.40) |
| SCHLAFEN area | 13.4 m² | 14.24 m² (3.485 × 4.085) |
| BAD area | 6.9 m² | 7.67 m² (3.485 × 2.20) |

findings.element: Top horizontal dimension chain (30 / 5.86 / 11,5 / 4.00 / 30) vs. overall dimension 10.00
findings.explanation: The sub-dimensions add up to 0.30 + 5.86 + 0.115 + 4.00 + 0.30 = 10.575 m, but the overall dimension above it reads 10.00 m and the building is in fact drawn 10.00 m wide (283.46 pt at 1:100). The chain is 57.5 cm too long. The two culprits are the 5.86 and 4.00 segments (see below); the 30 / 11,5 / 30 values are correct as drawn.

findings.element: Chain dimension between inner face of left exterior wall and left face of the interior partition (clear width of WOHNEN)
findings.explanation: Drawn from x=121.89 pt to x=286.30 pt = 164.41 pt, which at 1:100 is exactly 5.800 m. The label reads 5.86 m, i.e. 6 cm too large.

findings.element: Chain dimension between right face of the interior partition and inner face of the right exterior wall (clear width of SCHLAFEN / BAD)
findings.explanation: Drawn from x=289.56 pt to x=388.35 pt = 98.79 pt, which at 1:100 is 3.485 m. The label reads 4.00 m, i.e. 51.5 cm too large. This is the main reason the chain overshoots the 10.00 m overall dimension.
The room is drawn 5.800 m x 6.400 m clear (164.41 pt x 181.42 pt at 1:100), giving 37.12 m2. The label understates the area by 5.9 m2 (~16%).
The room is drawn 3.485 m x 4.085 m clear (98.79 pt x 115.80 pt at 1:100), giving 14.24 m2. The label understates the area by 0.84 m2 (~6%).

The room is drawn 3.485 m x 2.200 m clear (98.79 pt x 62.36 pt at 1:100), giving 7.67 m2. The label understates the area by 0.77 m2 (~10%). Cross-check: the three labelled areas total 51.5 m2, whereas the net internal area of the drawn plan (9.400 x 6.400 minus the two 11.5 cm partitions) is 59.03 m2.
